intro.title: Grid: container and template
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a simple webpage layout using CSS Grid to arrange content into rows and columns. You will learn the core concept of defining a grid container and specifying its template structure. The main technologies involved are CSS Grid properties like `display: grid`, `grid-template-columns`, and `grid-template-rows`. This beginner-friendly lesson will guide you through creating a structured layout step by step, helping you understand how to control the placement of elements on a page.
intro.usecase: CSS Grid's container and template properties are foundational for building complex, responsive layouts in modern web applications. Developers use them to create structured interfaces like product dashboards with aligned data panels, media galleries with consistent image grids, and content-heavy pages with sidebars and main areas. Mastering these concepts allows you to efficiently arrange UI components—such as filter controls, data cards, or navigation menus—into predictable, maintainable layouts that adapt seamlessly across devices.
